title: finish the MGnify cutoffs run: gather, reject and learn have never run
body: The MGnify reversed set was drawn (501 G, 1000 shards, 2,455,940 sequences a shard, 62.5 minutes) and recruit ran over 100 of the 1000 shards before it was stopped deliberately. Those 200 tables are in sets/cutoffs/outputs/recruit/results/. gather, reject and learn have not run on MGnify at all. data/mgy-cutoffs.tbl is from an earlier harness.

notes.author: jackroddy/21204bf1
notes.text: Decided 6 Oct: recruit restarts from scratch over all 1000 shards with both tools, no resume added; the 100 done shards are redone (~9 h of ~90). Strategy fixed: nail and mmseqs recruit, hmmsearch alone rejects at -Z 2,455,940 (commit 5b03f2d). Reject's cost at this scale is unmeasured; 7c8146 times fanout against union and could run on the old 100-shard recruit tables while recruit runs.
